Compared versions: gold is updown_counter.v [artifact:prj-f735fc7be7.design-under-test.a1] (sha256:a6b63a877179dfe4417a37a116d8399e0dc1b596bbd5e3a25e061c92b882f5ca). Both declare module updown_counter with the same ports (clk, rst, load, din[3:0], en, up, q[3:0], carry, borrow) and the same state register q[3:0]. Mapping should therefore be by name: outputs q, carry and borrow, plus state register q. No point is expected to be unmapped. Manual reading, which is not a tool result: (1) Gate up-count: chain[i]=&q[i-1:0], which toggles each bit whose lower bits are all 1. This equals q+1 mod 16. (2) Gate down-count: same=~q, so a bit toggles when all lower bits are 0. This equals q-1 mod 16. (3) edge_hit=&same is q==15 when up and q==0 when down. This matches the gold carry and borrow terms. (4) rst, load and en have the same priority in both versions. Setup file: equiv/updown_counter.eqy. A completed result requires the platform's equivalence.run over that file. === FILE: equiv/updown_counter.eqy ===
[options]
splitnets on

[gold]
read_verilog updown_counter.v
prep -top updown_counter

[gate]
read_verilog updown_counter_refactor.v
prep -top updown_counter

[strategy sby]
use sby
depth 5
engine smtbmc
=== END FILE ===
